benefits.name: United Club Membership
benefits.description: Unlimited United Club access for the cardholder and one guest.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Cardholder plus one guest. All Access membership — which admits two adult guests, or one adult guest plus dependent children, and adds Star Alliance lounge access — unlocks at Premier Gold status or $50,000 in annual spend.

benefits.name: Two Free Checked Bags
benefits.description: First and second standard checked bags free for the primary Cardmember and one companion on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Applies to United- and United Express-operated flights.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $120 for a Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee.

benefits.name: Renowned Hotels and Resorts Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 annually in statement credits on prepaid bookings with Renowned Hotels and Resorts.

benefits.name: Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Up to $150 annually in statement credits on eligible rideshare purchases.

benefits.name: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: Up to $240 annually in Instacart statement credits.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Benefit ends 12/31/27 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Avis and Budget Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 annually in United travel credits on Avis or Budget rentals.

benefits.name: JSX Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 annually in statement credits on JSX flight purchases.

benefits.name: 25% Back on United Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on United inflight purchases and premium drink purchases at United Clubs.

benefits.name: United Premier Access
benefits.description: Priority check-in, security screening, boarding, and baggage handling on United flights.

benefits.name: 10,000-Mile Award Flight Discounts
benefits.description: Up to two 10,000-mile award flight discounts per calendar year after spending $20,000.
benefits.terms: Requires $20,000 in purchases per calendar year.

benefits.name: Award Flight Savings
benefits.description: Save 10% when booking United flights with miles; Premier members save 15%.

benefits.name: Card Bonus Premier Qualifying Points
benefits.description: 1,500 Card Bonus PQP each year, plus 1 PQP per $15 spent up to 28,000 PQP per calendar year.
benefits.terms: The 1,500 Card Bonus PQP is awarded within 8 weeks of February 1. Spend-based PQP capped at 28,000 per calendar year.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status.

benefits.name: Avis President's Club Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Avis President's Club membership.

benefits.name: Complimentary Instacart+ Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Instacart+ membership.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars, up to $60,000.
benefits.terms: Primary coverage. Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per covered traveler for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per covered traveler for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $500 per item when a merchant will not accept a return within 90 days of purchase.

earningRates.terms: 5x miles from the card on eligible United purchases. United flights earn 11x total when combined with the 6x earned as a MileagePlus member.
Hotel stays booked through Renowned Hotels and Resorts.
